name: @foreverworks/mcp-google
description: MCP server for several Google accounts at once: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Tasks, contacts and Meet transcripts

GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_FILE.title: OAuth client file
GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_FILE.description: Path of your OAuth client's JSON (a Desktop app client from the Google Cloud console).

GMAIL_ADDRESSES.title: Accounts and their addresses
GMAIL_ADDRESSES.description: Each account's label and address, e.g. personal=ana@example.com,work=ana@example.org.

GMAIL_MODIFY_ACCOUNTS.title: Where Gmail grants are kept
GMAIL_MODIFY_ACCOUNTS.description: Where each mailbox's Gmail grant is kept, e.g. personal=/path/to/grants/gmail-personal.json; consent writes it there. Without it the other products work, but no mailbox does.

CALENDAR_TIME_ZONE.title: Calendar time zone
CALENDAR_TIME_ZONE.description: The time zone a time without an offset is read in, e.g. Europe/Paris.

author: Forever Works
